# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolchild  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face with black eyes. He carries himself with an impertinent swagger.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, impertinent, and mischievous boy who holds a prejudice against female teachers, believing they are no good. He exhibits a scornful air of toleration when obeying rules, often showing mock grin or curiosity. Although he behaves with bravado and mocking scorn toward his teacher, he remains capable of being brought to tears when punished.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

## Traits

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

After being taken in as an orphan by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, Anthony began attending school under Anne Shirley. From his first day, he looked upon his new teacher with hostility and contempt, believing female teachers were useless. He engaged in mischievous acts, such as pouring slate-bottle water down Aurelia Clay's neck and ignoring gentle lectures about acting like a gentleman. Eventually, after a stunt involving a mouse in Anne's desk drawer, Anne lost her temper and whipped him with a pointer, causing his bravado to fail and bringing him to tears.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034)_
